## Requirements: Issue-selected Playwright E2E execution and trusted per-ID reporting

### Background
Currently `.github/workflows/e2e-tests.yml` runs `./gates/run e2e-playwright`, which invokes `./e2e/run test --all` on PRs to staging/main and on staging pushes. The Acceptance Orchestrator polls the **whole E2E workflow** by SHA; it cannot distinguish Issue-declared selected regressions from Full E2E. Existing `e2e-test-ingest.yml` ingests only **successful staging/main push** runs and `scripts/e2e-test-run-ingest.mjs` retains mainly a workflow-level Playwright report receipt, not authenticated per-spec results, so failed PR scenarios cannot currently be projected to Issues.

**Decision:** PR E2E validation must use Issue-declared `New + Regression` **file IDs under `e2e/tests/` only**, and report **each required ID's Pass/Fail/Pending/Error and evidence back to each linked Issue**. Full regression remains a separate retained policy for staging/manual (and optionally scheduled/release) runs. Do not create a Code→Capability map, a new E2E runtime, new general orchestration system, or a new Issue/SC projector.

### Contract and execution
1. On PR opened/synchronize/reopened/related Issue contract update, trusted planning tooling locates actual linked requirement/bug Issues through existing reference discovery, loads their canonical E2E Verification declarations (#1701) and validates exact target PR-head SHA against the canonical `e2e/tests/` file-ID catalog (#1700).
2. Required set = union of all linked Issues' `New + Regression` IDs **plus any runnable `e2e/tests/**/*.spec.ts` directly added/modified by this PR** (including documented rename behavior). Missing Issue declarations, unknown/renamed IDs, unexplained `none`, invalid base/SHA or ambiguous linkage fail closed; do not turn empty plans into a green test job.
3. Produce a deterministic, bounded **Selection Plan**: `PR, target_sha, base_sha, issue_numbers, issue_contract_digests, selected_IDs, reason/source, catalog/source revision, plan_digest`. Treat Issue text and PR-head files as untrusted planning inputs, not privileged instructions.
4. Execute selected spec files through one `./e2e/run test --id ...` / Playwright process and **one isolated Server+Agent+Web+tmux lifecycle**. A PR with justified `none` and no changed test files receives a verified `not-required` outcome, not a fabricated Playwright Pass. Keep the canonical full `e2e-playwright` Gate semantics unchanged; route selective execution through a separate owning selector/Gate (or an explicitly versioned mode without weakening old full-suite coverage).
5. Produce machine-readable **per-ID results** from Playwright JSON and assertion evidence, even when the overall selected run fails. Aggregate all cases within a file. `Pass` requires the selected spec to exist, be discovered, execute required assertions and pass without skipped/flaky outcomes; assertion failure = `Fail`; missing/incomplete/unproven = `Pending` or `Error`. Distinguish runner/environment errors. Upload artifacts on failure, not only success.
6. On `workflow_run completed`, main-owned trusted ingestion authenticates source repo/workflow/run attempt, exact SHA, immutable selection plan/digest, Issue contract digests and file-ID results before persisting sanitized immutable records on **existing `acceptance-results` orphan branch**. Only trusted projection writes Issue `E2E Report`, with one current result/evidence link per Issue/ID; **both success and failure must be reflected**. No write/secrets in PR-head browser test executor and no raw page/terminal/sensitive logs in Issue comments or public run records.
7. Final deterministic Issue E2E gate passes only if every required ID for the current plan/SHA has authenticated Pass; fails or stays Pending/Error otherwise. A new PR head or changed Issue requirement invalidates prior proof, with safe idempotency on retries, duplicates, out-of-order completions and concurrent PR updates. Equivalent execution can be reused only with matching target SHA, test definition, runtime/config and plan-compatible evidence.
8. Drive Acceptance coordination via completed-event/reconciliation rather than a long runner-occupying polling loop; it must accept **Selected E2E proof as selected-only**, never misrepresent it as a successful Full E2E. Preserve existing Quality Gate/SC-method boundaries and verify the required GitHub PR check remains attached to the actual PR head SHA. Avoid `workflow_run` recursive depth and result-update→test-update feedback loops.
9. Existing `push: staging` (and documented other explicit full-suite triggers) remains Full Regression; record `scope: full` vs `scope: selected` separately. Maintain compatibility with existing `e2e-test-ingest.yml` consumers/history during safe cutover; workflow YAML remains thin. `.github/workflows/*` modifications must follow main-based isolated PR policy in `.github/AGENTS.md`.

### Dependencies / boundaries
- **Blocked by #1700** (stable per-file E2E ID / execution).
- **Blocked by #1701** (Issue New + Regression declaration).
- Integrate, do not duplicate: #1649 Acceptance Orchestrator, #1474 E2E Runner/evidence, #1664 Developer/Reviewer Agent workflow (may improve coverage selection, but no required model call in deterministic scheduling).
- This issue is the active CI/feedback implementation. No new Acceptance Case manifests or Scenario IDs.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 A real PR linked to two Issues generates the exact-SHA deterministic union of both `New + Regression` lists plus changed/new spec files, with per-Issue attribution; a duplicate ID runs once without losing either Issue's required result.
- [x] SC-02 The selected PR run invokes only the declared/mandatory `e2e/tests/` IDs through one full-stack runtime, while staging push still runs the full Playwright suite and old full-suite Gate semantics are unchanged.
- [ ] SC-03 A real executed failing Playwright ID appears as `Fail` with its precise source-run link on each owning Issue while other passing IDs report `Pass`; workflow-level failure never suppresses per-ID artifacts/results. Missing, skipped, flaky, zero-execution and infrastructure failures cannot Pass.
- [x] SC-04 Source workflow/run/attempt, checkout SHA, source tree, test file identities, plan digest, Issue requirements and machine-readable per-file results are independently authenticated by main-owned ingestion, then written immutably and idempotently to `acceptance-results` without exposing PR-head execution to Issue-write credentials.
- [x] SC-05 The current Issue E2E Report is updated by a **single trusted projector** for both success and failure, with the exact ID, state, run URL, SHA and evidence; source PR code, manual report edits and stale run outcomes cannot forge successful proof.
- [x] SC-06 A later SHA, edited Issue New/Regression declaration, renamed/deleted ID, rerun attempt, duplicate completion or out-of-order result cannot reuse or overwrite a newer current Issue verdict; negative tests prove conservative reconciliation.
- [x] SC-07 A documented `none` Issue with no changed E2E is accepted as `not-required` only after validation; missing/bad declarations or unknown IDs fail closed and never appear as successful empty selections.
- [ ] SC-08 Acceptance orchestration starts from completed verified outcomes (without runner polling for full E2E), preserves exact-head required checks and does not equate selected-suite success with full regression success; live PR integration demonstrates transition to the existing SC gate with no stale-SHA acceptance.
- [x] SC-09 Repository Gate/CI, workflow naming/subscriptions, docs and existing orphan Run Record consumers remain valid after migration; live staging full-regression evidence and failed-PR per-ID ingestion both remain traceable.

- none: Test selection and provenance tooling introduces no new browser-visible scenario.

## Live E2E Verification Evidence (read-only references)

The following are **historical run references for trusted SC review**, not edits to the E2E Report or manual SC approvals.

- PR [#1718](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/1718) links Issues #1702 and #1717. The Issue-selected union is `login` (declared by both Issues) plus `session-lifecycle` (declared by #1702), with one owning plan per exact SHA.
- **Fail revision** `ce4f6183d896ba8eb46138e32980724895379faf`: [E2E Run 38497155817](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/38497155817), `login=Fail`, `session-lifecycle=Pass`. The main-owned [Ingest Run 38497591606](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/38497591606) published the failed per-ID verdict to both Issues, preserving the failed-run artifact; original plan digest `d77fb21fc08c2b35cd870fbb51ad3b7c3e57058956d6568ea001b01fbc55476c`.
- **Corrected revision** `437ed739977462a510140a62efba31176e59323c`: [E2E Run 38502091691](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/38502091691) succeeded with `login=Pass`, `session-lifecycle=Pass`, supported by executed Playwright assertion receipts. [Ingest Run 38502574201](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/38502574201) independently validated the evidence and updated both Issues to the current SHA with plan digest `c9ecdbcdb350f5ec96d86e7d40f8de62c77f985be9bf034e0e2fa0cbd0a26ef9`.
- **Directly inspected immutable ZIP artifacts:** failed Run artifact [#11863654906](https://api.github.com/repos/BestNathan/nession/actions/artifacts/11863654906) and corrected Run artifact [#11866462565](https://api.github.com/repos/BestNathan/nession/actions/artifacts/11866462565) both contain `plan.json`, `results.json`, `assertions.json` and `playwright.json`. Both `plan.json` files select **exactly two stable IDs, one execution per ID**: `login → owners=[#1702, #1717]` and `session-lifecycle → owners=[#1702]` (same base SHA `aa823aa2ecc32b3cb9e54dd5196c4b0fa8147a1d`, different exact head SHA/digest). Failed `results.json`: `login=Fail, discovered=1, failed=1, assertions=9`; `session-lifecycle=Pass, discovered=1, assertions=18`. Corrected `results.json`: `login=Pass, discovered=1, passed=1, assertions=2`; `session-lifecycle=Pass, discovered=1, passed=1, assertions=18`. The success artifact digest is `sha256:f6ada5fd51b6a05cfb69f8bb4a380705d319ffae320ce2c16768e476955e9ecf`. This is sourced from the **actual uploaded run archives**, not synthesized from code-level unit tests or assumed from the new SHA alone.
- **Real stale-result replay:** the original trusted [Ingest Run 38497591606, attempt 2](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/38497591606) was deliberately re-executed *after* the correction. Its `ingest-pr` job was rejected at `verifySource` with `AssertionError: stale PR head` (not a generic runner failure), before any Issue write. Both Issue E2E Reports remain `Pass` from Run `38502091691` at SHA `437ed739`. The original Fail Run and new Pass Run have separate immutable records; negative fixture tests in `scripts/issue-e2e-reconcile.mjs` additionally cover duplicate and out-of-order run attempts.

## Product alignment
- [x] Engineering-only verification; no nession product UI changes.
- [x] E2E Runner, Gates, SC projector and Orchestrator retain separate owners.
- [x] Source tests cannot self-publish trusted Issue/SC verdicts.
- [x] Selective PR tests do not erase full-suite coverage or prior evidence.
